A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable and describe the same DGAF-VSR work. However, v1 includes nine supplementary pages, whereas v2 ends after its references while citing Supplementary 1–14. The main texts support reliable comparison; changes within the later supplementary material cannot be checked.

before.justification: v1 reports original VSR experiments on REDS4, Vid4 and VideoLQ, feature analyses, and main-text and supplementary ablations.

after.justification: v2 retains original benchmark results, feature analyses and ablations in Sections 3 and 5, and adds baseline results in Table 1.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Figure 3 retain RAFT flow estimation, upscale–warp–downscale alignment, alternating temporal guidance, and the full guiding U-Net with frozen denoising U-Net and VAE. The new BrushNet attribution does not establish an algorithm or architecture change.

E1.justification: Both main texts retain REDS/REDS4, Vid4 and VideoLQ coverage. v1 additionally documents 8× and 16× VSR in Supplementary 8; v2 refers scale-factor comparisons to unavailable Supplementary 10. Their retention or revision cannot be established.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds DOVE and SeedVR2 on both REDS4 and Vid4, expanding the diffusion-based comparator set from four to six. The existing Table 1 comparators and the VideoLQ comparator set in Table 2 remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The visible benchmark scales and metrics remain unchanged. However, v1 Supplementary 7 specifies training splits, preprocessing, budgets and sampling settings, while v2 delegates these to unavailable Supplementary 8. Protocol changes and settings for the added baselines cannot be reliably assessed.

E4.justification: Main Table 3 retains identical dense-guidance and interpolation ablations. v1 also supplies operator comparisons, diffusion-step and rescaling analyses, efficiency measurements, and additional component ablations. v2 references corresponding supplementary analyses without supplying them, preventing comparison of their contents.

E5.justification: Neither supplied PDF reports experimental seeds, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals or significance tests. The retained standard-deviation quantity measures feature correlation, rather than uncertainty in experimental results.

E6.justification: Table 1 adds four result rows for DOVE and SeedVR2 across REDS4 and Vid4. All 20 retained rows match exactly, including DGAF-VSR PSNR values of 28.17 and 24.75 dB. Tables 2–3 and matched main-text findings are unchanged; supplementary result changes cannot be checked.

T1.justification: The diffusion definitions and Equations 1–4 remain mathematically equivalent. v2 clarifies reconstructed-frame indices and adjacent feature/frame pairs, without introducing a new formal assumption, derivation or proof.

C1.justification: The two motivating observations, OGWM and FTCM contributions, and claimed perceptual, fidelity and temporal benefits remain the same. The abstract retains the 35.82% DISTS reduction, 0.20 dB PSNR gain and 30.37% tLPIPS reduction; its revised motivation does not materially change these claims.

C2.justification: The shared main text retains its explanations of feature correlations, frequency preservation and temporal consistency. v1 Supplementary 13 discusses limitations from the scale-specific backbone and possible transfer through task adaptation. Without v2's supplementary material, changes to these limitations and other supplementary interpretations cannot be determined.

D1.justification: v2 newly provides a GitHub source-code availability statement in the abstract; external availability was not verified. This is a confirmed access-information addition. Changes to the detailed hardware, optimizer, augmentation and training disclosures in v1 cannot be checked against v2's unavailable supplement.

R1.justification: Section 4.2 newly credits BrushNet as inspiration for the full guiding U-Net, and DOVE and SeedVR2 enter the comparison discussion. Brief VideoGigaGAN and TOFlow descriptions are removed. The new citations render as unresolved placeholders, and the promised supplementary BrushNet comparison is unavailable.

P1.justification: The shared main text preserves its section sequence and most wording. Local edits reframe the abstract's motivation, clarify adjacent-variable comparisons, shorten related-work descriptions, and update affiliations and acknowledgments. The later supplementary organization cannot be inspected.

P2.justification: The main article undergoes substantial reformatting: the full-width abstract becomes single-column, running headers and crop marks disappear, and typography and figure/table placement change throughout. Figure 3 is redrawn with the same architecture, Table 1 gains rows, and the temporal plot and profile figures exchange numbering and placement.

improvement.justification: v2 adds useful baseline comparisons, explicit BrushNet attribution and a code pointer while retaining the existing method and results. However, its new citations are unresolved, and the referenced supplementary material needed to assess settings, additional evidence and limitations is absent. These gaps prevent a reliable paper-level judgment of net improvement.
